name: Avinyonet de Puigventós (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, the white charged with ten purple discs in the upper hoist and the red with a white Maltese cross in the lower hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 13 November 2008 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 5268 of 28 November 2008; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, horizontal bicolour white and red, with ten purple discs in four rows of 4, 3, 2 and 1 at 1/10 from the upper edge and 1/15 from the hoist (arms approved 5 July 1984).

features.role: ten discs in rows of 4, 3, 2 and 1
